name: Plate XXXVI: The Pentalpha
description: The pentagram of the Pythagoreans, sign of Hygieia, whose heart holds a smaller star, and that one another, without end. Struck in Vermilion: cinnabar, the red sulphide of mercury. Degree of Magus, rank 16 of the folio. “ORA LEGE LEGE LEGE RELEGE LABORA ET INVENIES”: Pray, read, read, read, reread, work, and you will find (Mutus Liber).
